questions.stem: In which practice is the concept of Data Drift used?
questions.explanation: Data Drift is a Data Science concept used to evaluate the trained versus actual performance of machine learning models.

options: A change in the data elements a model uses
A change of data within the same selected data elements
A change in the model's code
A change in the project scope
questions.explanation: Data Drift is a change of data within the same selected data elements; the elements and the model stay the same, but the data arriving changes.

questions.stem: By which other names is Data Drift known?
options: Covariate shift, virtual drift or virtual concept drift
Class drift, real concept drift or posterior probability shift
Sudden drift, gradual drift or incremental drift
questions.explanation: Data Drift is also known as covariate shift, virtual drift or virtual concept drift.

questions.stem: In the products example, what causes the Data Drift?
options: The list of product types growing from 10 during training to 15 in production
The database being migrated to the cloud
questions.explanation: The model was trained on 10 product types but production has 15; the data element is still 'product', yet new values the model cannot recognise have appeared.

questions.stem: In the products example, how might model accuracy change after Data Drift?
options: It drops from around 85% to perhaps below 70%
questions.explanation: A model that gave about 85% accuracy may drop to around 70% or below when unexpected product types appear.

questions.stem: Which statement about Data Drift is correct?
options: It means there is something wrong with the model
It means the model's data elements have changed
It is a completely unexpected behaviour
It is one of the most expected behaviours in every data modelling
questions.explanation: Data Drift is one of the most expected behaviours in data modelling; it is not a fault in the model but a change in the incoming data.

questions.stem: Why must an organisation have automated ways to track and identify Data Drift?
options: Because drift changes the project scope
Because after drift there is a high chance the model will not predict with the planned accuracy, and wrong predictions mean wrong decisions
questions.explanation: After Data Drift the model is likely to fall short of its expected accuracy, and wrong predictions lead to wrong decisions.

questions.stem: What is the remedy for Data Drift?
options: Retrain the model quickly in the training environment and deploy it again
Change the data elements used by the model
questions.explanation: To handle Data Drift you retrain the model in the training environment and redeploy it.

options: Shifting or moving from one point to another, but not in a standard approach
questions.explanation: Drift is about shifting or moving from one point to another in a non-standard way.

questions.stem: Which scenario would NOT count as Data Drift in the products example?
options: Five new product types appearing in production
Product data extending beyond the training set
Product values the model was not trained on
The model's accuracy falling because of unrecognised products
Salary data starting to arrive instead of product data
questions.explanation: Data Drift keeps the same data element; a switch from product data to salary data would be a change of data elements, which is not Data Drift.
